title: The Appearance of Antiphage Antibodies in Sera of Patients Treated with Phages
content: Bacteriophages are neutralized by sera of patients undergoing phage therapy (PT) particularly during local or both local and oral phage administration in bone infections, soft tissue infections or upper respiratory tract infections. In parallel to these results, it has been shown that strong an-tiphage humoral response does not prevent a positive outcome of phage treatment. Our prelim-inary results suggest that high levels of antiphage antibodies appear late in the treatment period, at the earliest in the 3rd-8th week of PT.
